description: This file defines the class LocaleDefaultConfigStorage, which manages access to default locale configuration data in Drupal, including reading configuration, listing all configurations, and handling predefined languages.

classes.name: LocaleDefaultConfigStorage
classes.description: Manages access to default locale configuration, including reading, listing, and handling predefined languages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the storage with configuration and language manager, setting up required and optional install storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads configuration data from install storage or default languages based on the name.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all configuration names from install storage and current languages.

methods.name: getComponentNames
methods.description: Retrieves configuration names for modules, themes, or profiles, including predefined languages if applicable.

methods.name: predefinedConfiguredLanguages
methods.description: Computes and returns configuration names matching predefined languages.
